content: The third component, Language Style Recovery Module (LSRM), recovers the language style of $c_t$ without its dialogue by training the BERT bi-ranker model BIBREF28 to rank responses from similar characters. Our results demonstrate higher accuracy at retrieving the ground truth response from $c_t$. Our system is also able to pick responses which are correct both in context as well as character space.
